purpose: The historical builder ships LABOR[2016] and LABOR[2021] as constants. The 2026 build refuses to invent the equivalent: fill this file from a published HCP release, with the publisher, the URL and a known_as_of at or before the snapshot date.
validation_note: As shipped this file FAILS validate_labour_context on purpose. A build cannot start until an operator replaces the nulls with sourced proportions in [0,1].
